module.title: Repair the remaining restaurant roster
module.question: Which supplied complete repairs cover every remaining service within the recorded staffing and expense limits?
module.description: Compare four supplied complete repairs for the remaining Friday–Sunday services in one published week; this is not a generator for all possible rosters.

units.timeOrigin: Monday 00:00 of one fictional week; one local clock without a daylight-saving transition

assumptions: All people, availability, qualifications, flat fees, hours and limits are fictional authored inputs, not validated employment records.

Fixed four-hour service positions need two qualified cooks and one qualified server throughout. No individual can fill simultaneous positions. This fixture has no in-shift breaks; a required break must be removed from available working intervals and covered by an explicitly supplied repair.
The supplied comparison contains four complete remaining rosters, not every possible repair. A preferred result is established only within those four alternatives.

Nora’s cancelled shift is unpaid and excluded from the retained $656 remaining-payroll baseline. Change count compares assigned people at each published position, including Nora’s replacement; it is not a count of individual employees or a measure of fairness.

Earlier-week work is retained as per-person minute totals and the end of the latest earlier shift; this comparison does not retrospectively audit earlier assignments. The declared ten-hour rest and forty-hour limits are model assumptions, not labor-law compliance findings.

The model checks the recorded intervals and roles. Demand forecasts, workload intensity, payroll premiums, consent, seniority, transport and actual publication require additional records, rules or integrations.

requirements.label: Every required position filled
requirements.meaning: Each recorded service has two distinct cook positions and one server position filled for its complete interval.

requirements.label: Required qualifications
requirements.meaning: The assigned employee has the declared qualification for the position.

requirements.label: Full-interval availability
requirements.meaning: Recorded availability, with any unavailable intervals omitted, covers every minute of each assignment.

requirements.label: One assignment at a time
requirements.meaning: No employee simultaneously fills two positions or overlaps a retained booking.

requirements.label: Declared rest between shifts
requirements.meaning: The gap from earlier work and between remaining assignments is at least the declared ten hours.

requirements.label: Declared weekly hours
requirements.meaning: Retained earlier-week minutes plus the candidate’s remaining assignments stay within the declared forty-hour limit.

requirements.label: Remaining labor budget
requirements.meaning: Complete remaining payroll is at most $856; available additional labor is $200 against the retained $656 baseline.

requirements.label: Counting basis
requirements.meaning: Boolean counts map false to zero and true to one; assigned four-hour slots contribute zero or 240 minutes.

Earlier-week work is retained as per-person minute totals and the end of the latest earlier shift; this comparison does not retrospectively audit earlier assignments. The declared ten-hour rest and forty-hour limits are model assumptions, not labor-law compliance findings.

The model checks the recorded intervals and roles. Demand forecasts, workload intensity, payroll premiums, consent, seniority, transport and actual publication require additional records, rules or integrations.

Fictional restaurant. Week starts Monday at 00:00. Earlier-week work totals and last shift ends are retained; every remaining recorded service is compared. Nora’s cancelled Saturday shift is unpaid and removed from the expense baseline. Other retained work is paid at its declared flat four-hour fee. No payroll, booking, messaging or operating authority is issued.
Monday 00:00 of one fictional week; one local clock without a daylight-saving transition
Each recorded service has two distinct cook positions and one server position filled for its complete interval.
The assigned employee has the declared qualification for the position.
Recorded availability, with any unavailable intervals omitted, covers every minute of each assignment.
No employee simultaneously fills two positions or overlaps a retained booking.
The gap from earlier work and between remaining assignments is at least the declared ten hours.
Retained earlier-week minutes plus the candidate’s remaining assignments stay within the declared forty-hour limit.
Complete remaining payroll is at most $856; available additional labor is $200 against the retained $656 baseline.
Boolean counts map false to zero and true to one; assigned four-hour slots contribute zero or 240 minutes.
